title: Pearly’s program
author: Felix is small
desc:
Time to organize that gym time! So I have this set up where you have an upper body day, a lower body, and a full body day. The upper and lower are ganna be mainly weight lifting to burn the most calories and get the most bang for out time. I also have some chill cardio on those days at the end if you still have time. The full body day will be parts of the upper and lower with a harder cardio session at the end(this ones not optional lol). If you have flat shoes like Chucks or Vans for the lower body lifting that’s best, but if not just the most stable workout shoes you have should be ok. 

VERY IMPORTANT!!!!
Before the first lift on a muscle group you need to do at least 1 warm up set. This can be as simple as half the weight of a working set and the same reps. If you want more warm up you can 75% of the working weight for second warm up set. This is what will keep you safe and help your joints get used to the movement. When you do the second movement for that body part you can do another warm up set but you don’t have to.

For all of the lifting movements I want you to use a weight where you feel like you can only do 1-3 more reps while still being in the target range. It’s ganna be tough but really try to push yourself. Try to control the weight the entire time, especially on the way down. This is for safety and to helps get you the most for your effort. You don’t have to be a nerd about it but half a second to a second on the way down is a good rule of thumb. 

If you are able to complete all the sets at the top of the rep range add 5-10lbs next time you do that movement. For the body weight stuff I’ll specify how to progress on those in the actual workouts. 

All the cardio is on the treadmill but you can swap it out for any other form of cardio if running is stressful on your joints. The Elliptical and row machines are great alternatives. 

Also any movement you don’t like or feel comfortable doing can de swapped for something similar. (Ex. Smith machine Squat changed to Goblet squat, Romanian deadlifts swapped for dumbbell stiff legged deadlifts) I can provide you some alternative if you’d like. 

If you click the name of the exercises it should show you a model or video of how to do them well but if you want something more I can send you something better or a video of me doing it. If you want to see if you are doing it right I can also check your form out too. 

If you have any questions just let me know :)

ex.note: Focus on getting low without having your low back round. This will get you knees over your toes a lot and that’s fine. If you have trouble with ankle mobility add small plates under your heels.
Use the Smith machine but it’s basically the same. Focus on keeping a straight back and tight core. Don’t let the knees go forward and go down until you feel a big ass stretch in the hamstrings.
If you can’t do full leg raises just lift your knees till you get 30. Focus on getting your hips tilted up to use the abs more. It should feel like a crunch and not only sore in you legs.
The further and deeper you can get the better. Alternate legs and 1 reps is after you do both legs.
Don’t start off weighted until you can do the 15 reps bodyweight. Try to get the pad to stop on your upper thigh, not the hip. Keep a flat back and lift with glutes and hamstrings.
Walk on the treadmill at a decent speed. Incline should be 5 to start and you can increase it if you want it to get harder.
I recommend holding the handles at 45 degrees for comfort. Keep a small arch in the back, mainly by shoulders back and down. This will help prevent shoulder pain.
Find a handle and width you like and keep that consistent. Get the bar below the neck to count the rep. Let the bar go all the way up to get best stretch.
Focus on using holding your torso straight with the unloaded obliques. Each side for 30 seconds is one set. Go up to 90 seconds and then go up in weight
If you can’t do flat push ups start doing them with your hands on a bench. Once you get to 25 go to regular. And once you get to 25 again raise your legs.
Let the machine pull your back apart to get the most stretch. Try not to use too much momentum but a little is ok. Think about bringing the elbows back as fast as a possible.
After a couple minute walking warm up try to jog at a pace where you could speak in full sentences. If you start getting too winded slow down or start speed walking until you can jog again.
AMRAP just means as many reps as possible. Just do one set till all out failure. Use dumbbell in your feel for stability.
After a short slow jog/walk warm up you are going to be run/walking. 1 minute hard running(almost sprinting), 4 minutes jogging/walking. Add more running time as you get better.
